notes: «قلت لأيوب» : Hammad asks, and Ayyub answers (the one asked and answers is a link, rule 5), so Ayyub is the link after Hammad; his own report runs through Qatada to Abu Hurayra.
«قال أيوب فقدم علينا كثير» is a later episode in which Kathir denies the report: not a route. Surfaces are written as they stand in «لأيوب».
